providers.name: OpenAI
providers.context_template: Top up OpenAI API credits by ${{amount}} USD. The agent's API calls are failing with quota/credit errors. Provider: OpenAI. Purpose: restore API access so the coding session can continue.

providers.name: v0
providers.context_template: Top up v0 (Vercel AI) credits by ${{amount}} USD. The agent's generation requests are failing due to insufficient credits. Provider: v0 by Vercel. Purpose: restore generation access so the coding session can continue.
providers.notes: v0 has no standalone 'buy credits' button. The checkout automation clicks 'Add Card' to register the Link virtual card as a payment method, which can then be used for auto-recharge or plan upgrades. After the card is added, enable auto-recharge via the 'Enable' button on the billing page.
